# Three.js local runtime

Three.js 0.170.0 (r170), retrieved from the official npm package distribution on jsDelivr; package files are unmodified. License: MIT, included at `three/LICENSE`.

Only the engine, GLTFLoader, RoomEnvironment and BufferGeometryUtils required by these entry points are vendored. H.30 and H.29 comparison use the same r170 engine version. Runtime needs no remote CDN script.
